title: Indian Brussels Sprouts Casserole
description: A unique and flavorful twist on traditional Brussels sprouts, infused with Indian spices. This comforting casserole is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Trim the Brussels sprouts and cut them in half.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the Brussels sprouts and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the garam masala, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the Brussels sprouts for 15-20 minutes, or until tender and caramelized.
While the Brussels sprouts are roasting, melt the Dutch molten cheese in a saucepan over low heat.
Once the cheese is melted, stir in 1/4 cup of water to create a creamy sauce.
Remove the Brussels sprouts from the oven and transfer them to a baking dish.
Pour the cheese sauce over the Brussels sprouts and top with additional shredded cheese if desired.
Return the casserole to the oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
